items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: It's from my sister. She used to call me Habele.

ctx.x: Big Baby? Big Baby. That's, and I'm telling you brothers, they're famous too. That's what, no hollerin' about, no my name was William. They'd be a rich little. That's all they called them. Everybody, even their white people, you see, go. They got their called in there. Now when I started, around up where I live, like up here, and called them, well I used to play all the little white parties and everything. And they all know they know they're probably good because they didn't even before I ever come to New Orleans…
Is that from the French, the French name, the way they pronounce it Bebe? No, no. It's from my sister. She used to call me Habele.
Oh yeah. And from that, she started to call me Bebe, one of my sisters. I don't even know what she called. That's what Bebe means. Bebe.
